meta.name: decision-extraction
meta.description: Identify and formalize durable product and technical decisions from agent outputs into long-term memory. Activate after Discovery produces artefacts, Delivery resolves trade-offs, or product direction materially changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品和技术决策存入长期记忆
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在agent输出中捕捉关键决策并自动存档
copy.tagline_en: Save product and technical decisions into long-term memory
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to capture key decisions from agent outputs and archive them automatically

howto.what: Claude 会从对话或工件中识别出持久的、对治理有影响的决策（如架构选择、取舍、范围边界等），并将其结构化为 ADR 文件存入长期记忆。同时会检查新决策是否与已有决策冲突。
howto.when: 在发现产品规划工件、交付解决技术取舍、质量暴露系统性问题或产品方向重大变化后触发。不使用于琐碎步骤或头脑风暴。

say.text: 将刚才的架构选择记录下来。
say.note: 触发决策提取和一致性检查。

say.text: 检查这个决策是否与已有决策冲突。
将这次的技术取舍存入记忆。

howto.what_en: Claude identifies durable, governance-relevant decisions (e.g., architecture choices, trade-offs, scope boundaries) from conversation or artifacts, and structures them as ADR files in long-term memory. It also checks new decisions against existing ones for consistency.
howto.when_en: Triggered after discovery produces artifacts, delivery resolves trade-offs, QA surfaces systemic issues, or product direction changes. Not used for trivial steps or brainstorming.

say_en.text: Record the architecture choice we just made.
say_en.note: Triggers decision extraction and consistency check.

say_en.text: Check if this decision conflicts with any existing one.
Save this technical trade-off to memory.
